lesson: The system is consistently attempting to fade localized liquidity sweeps in a high-volatility environment, resulting in premature entries against the dominant trend. The reliance on low-confidence (30-43%) setups during structural bearish alignment has led to repeated stop-outs during mean-reversion attempts.
adjustment: Implement a 'Trend-Filter Rule' requiring a minimum 50% confidence score and confirmation of a Wyckoff Spring or Failure Swing on the 4H timeframe before entering any counter-trend position.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less in extreme fear regimes; prioritize macro structural alignment over localized 15m/30m order flow.
